Indonesia U23 vs Mali U23: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a fascinating friendly match where the Indonesia U23 Olympic team hosts one of Africa's strongest sides, the Mali U23 national team. This contest, part of the preparations for the U23 Asian Cup, will be a major test for the Indonesians against a representative from another continent.

Kick-off: November 15, 2025, 13:00 UTC (16:00 MSK)
Stadium: Manahan Stadium, Surakarta
Competition: International Friendly

Indonesia U23 vs Mali U23: Match Preview

Both teams come into this match as two of the most rapidly improving on their respective continents. Indonesia, under Shin Tae-yong, reached the U23 Asian Cup semifinals for the first time in history, narrowly missing out on an Olympic berth. Mali, the bronze medalists of the U23 Africa Cup of Nations, are similarly preparing for key competitions. This match represents a classic clash between Asian discipline and technique versus African strength and athleticism.

Team Form and Analysis

Indonesia U23

The 'Young Garudas' are experiencing a historic rise. The team plays an exciting, attacking style with quick wings and combination football. At home, backed by passionate supporters, Indonesia can compete with any opponent. Key players include abroad-based talents Rafael Struick, Ivar Jenner, and Justin Hubner.

Mali U23

The 'Eaglets' are traditionally one of Africa's strongest youth teams. They are known for their physicality, pace, and ability to secure results. The squad includes several talented players from European leagues with notable individual quality. For Mali, this match is an important preparation step and a chance to test themselves against a technical Asian team.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Indonesia U23 (3-4-3): Ernando; Ferrari, Hubner, Komang; Rio, Jenner, Ferdinan, Arhan; Witan, Struick, Kelly.
  • Mali U23 (4-3-3): Lassine; Guindo, Fofana, Cissé, Diakité; Diarra, Coulibaly, Traoré; Doumbia, Sangaré, Traoré.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Indonesia plays at home and is on the rise, Mali are the favorites on paper. Physical power and the higher quality of players competing in Europe should be decisive.

  • Main Prediction: Mali to Win or Draw (X2). Their athleticism and experience should allow them to avoid defeat against a motivated but physically weaker Indonesian side. A draw is also quite likely in a friendly game.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. Indonesia plays bravely at home and scores against almost everyone, while Mali have strong attacking potential. A goal exchange is expected.

Kazakhstan vs Belgium: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the Kazakhstan national team hosts one of the main favorites of the group and the entire tournament, the Belgium national team, at the Astana Arena. This is a David vs. Goliath showdown where the hosts will try to cause an upset with strong home support.

Kick-off: November 15, 2025, 14:00 UTC (17:00 MSK)
Stadium: Astana Arena, Astana
Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Kazakhstan vs Belgium: Match Preview

The teams enter this match from opposite sides of the group table. Belgium are the undisputed group leaders, having won all their matches and showing exceptional scoring form. Kazakhstan, on the other hand, are one of the underdogs but can trouble any opponent on home soil. The head-to-head record is fully in Belgium's favor: four matches, four wins, zero goals conceded.

Team Form and Analysis

Kazakhstan

The 'Hawks', under Stanislav Cherchesov (or his successor), are known for resilience and fighting spirit, particularly at home. The team relies on physicality, set pieces, and counter-attacks. The key player is versatile Beşiktaş footballer Bakhtiyar Zaynutdinov.

Belgium

The 'Red Devils' possess world-class stars across all positions. Belgium will dominate possession and apply constant pressure. Kevin De Bruyne, Romelu Lukaku, and Jérémy Doku lead the attack. The goal is a convincing victory and early qualification.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Kazakhstan (5-3-2): Shatskiy; Bystrov, Marochkin, Alip, Yerlanov, Vorogovskiy; Zaynutdinov, Tagybergen, Orazov; Aymbetov, Samorodov.
  • Belgium (4-3-3): Casteels; Castagne, Faes, Vertonghen, Theate; Tielemans, Onana, De Bruyne; Bakayoko, Lukaku, Doku.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Belgium are overwhelming favorites. The class difference is massive. It will be extremely difficult for Kazakhstan to challenge one of the strongest national teams in the world.

  • Main Prediction: Belgium to Win with a (-2) Handicap. One of the world's top teams should comfortably defeat the group underdog.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Belgium to Win to Nil. Belgium have never conceded against Kazakhstan in four meetings and will likely keep another clean sheet.

Russia vs Chile: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a fascinating friendly match where the Russian national team hosts one of South America's strongest sides, Chile, at VTB Arena in Moscow. This game will be a major test for Valery Karpin's team against a technical and resilient opponent.

Kick-off: November 15, 2025, 15:00 UTC (18:00 MSK)
Stadium: VTB Arena, Moscow
Competition: International Friendly

Russia vs Chile: Match Preview

The Russian national team continues its series of friendly matches against opponents from different confederations. Valery Karpin's squad is undergoing rebuilding and experimenting with new combinations. Chile, a two-time Copa América champion, remains known for its fighting spirit and technical style. This will be the first meeting between the teams in modern history.

Team Form and Analysis

Russia

Russia under Karpin focuses on pressing and fast attacking transitions. Recent friendlies show good scoring form but occasional defensive instability. Young talents like Arsen Zakharyan and Sergey Pinyaev are expected to play key roles. The home support in Moscow is a major advantage.

Chile

'La Roja' is going through a generational transition but remains a dangerous side. The team relies on possession, pressing, and the experience of veterans such as Alexis Sánchez and Arturo Vidal. A victory in Moscow would be a strong statement.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will appear 1 hour before kick-off.

  • Russia (4-3-3): Safonov; Gorshkov, Osipenko, Morozov, Khlusevich; Barinov, Glebov, Zakharyan; Pinyaev, Tyukavin, Oblyakov.
  • Chile (4-3-3): Bravo; Suazo, Díaz, Medel, Isla; Vidal, Pulgar, Núñez; Sánchez, Brereton Díaz, Dávila.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Even though it's a friendly, the match is expected to be intense and open. Russia is a slight favorite due to home advantage, but Chile's experience and technical skill make them a formidable opponent.

  • Main Prediction: Both teams to score. Russia scores regularly at home, while Chile's attack led by Sánchez is dangerous.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5. Both sides favor attacking play, and the friendly format often increases goal potential.

Brazil vs Senegal: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a super-match where one of the world's strongest national teams, Brazil, takes on the reigning champions of Africa, Senegal, at a neutral venue in Europe. This is a battle between two football giants from their respective continents that promises to be a true highlight of the football evening.

Kick-off: November 15, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK) Stadium: Emirates Stadium, London, England Competition: International Friendly

Brazil vs Senegal: Match Preview

Both teams come into this match as leaders of their confederations. The Brazilian national team, led by a new generation of stars, plays an exciting and attacking style of football. The Senegalese national team, in turn, is the main force in Africa, combining athleticism, tactical discipline, and the individual skill of players from top leagues. The only previous meeting between these teams took place in 2019 and ended in a 1-1 draw, which suggests that the upcoming match could also be a tight affair.

Team Form and Analysis

Brazil

The 'Seleção' are in the process of preparing for the World Cup qualifiers and see this match as a crucial stage of their training. The team will rely on ball control, individual brilliance, and fast combinations. Their attacking options include Vinícius Júnior, Rodrygo, Neymar, and many others.

Senegal

The 'Lions of Teranga,' under Aliou Cissé, are known for their organized and powerful play. The team boasts one of the best defensive lines in the world, with Kalidou Koulibaly being a standout. In attack, the main threat comes from Bayern Munich star Sadio Mané. The Senegalese will try to impose a physical battle and use their chances in fast counter-attacks.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Brazil (4-3-3): Alisson; Danilo, Marquinhos, Militão, Lodi; Casemiro, Paquetá, Guimarães; Vinícius, Richarlison, Rodrygo.
  • Senegal (4-3-3): E. Mendy; Sabaly, Koulibaly, Diallo, Jakobs; P. Sarr, N. Mendy, I. Gueye; I. Sarr, Dia, Mané.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Senegal are the champions of Africa, the Brazilian national team appear to be the favorites for this match. Their incredible selection of attacking players and higher class should be decisive. However, the Senegalese are capable of putting up a fight with their organization and physical power.

  • Main Prediction: Brazil to Win. The 'Seleção' will be looking to prove their status as one of the best teams in the world.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. Both sides have world-class forwards and may play openly in a friendly match.

Georgia vs Spain: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the Georgian national team hosts one of the main favorites not only of the group but of the entire tournament, the Spanish national team, at the Boris Paichadze Dinamo Arena in Tbilisi. For the hosts, this is a historic match and a chance to cause a sensation, while for 'La Furia Roja,' it's another step on the road to the World Cup.

Kick-off: November 15, 2025, 17:00 UTC (20:00 MSK) Stadium: Boris Paichadze Dinamo Arena, Tbilisi Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Georgia vs Spain: Match Preview

The teams approach this match with different objectives. The Spanish national team is the undisputed group leader, having won all their previous matches. The Georgian national team, in turn, is a solid mid-tier side that is capable of causing problems for any opponent on their home turf. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of Spain, who have won 6 of the last 7 encounters. However, the Spaniards' last visit to Tbilisi in 2021 was very challenging, ending in a victory for the visitors only in the 92nd minute (2-1). And in 2023, during the Euro qualifiers, 'La Furia Roja' secured a crushing 7-1 victory here.

Team Form and Analysis

Georgia

The 'Crusaders,' under Willy Sagnol, achieved a historic success by qualifying for Euro 2024 and are on the rise. The team relies on a solid defense and fast counter-attacks, where the star of Napoli, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, plays a key role. At home, with incredible support from their fans, the Georgian team will aim to challenge the formidable opponent.

Spain

'La Furia Roja' boasts a wealth of world-class stars in every position. The team will aim to dominate from the first minutes, control possession, and apply constant pressure on the opponent's goal. In attack, a new generation of talents led by Lamine Yamal and Nico Williams is shining. The Spanish will be looking for a convincing victory to secure their spot at the World Cup early.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Georgia (5-3-2): Mamardashvili; Gocholeishvili, Kvirkvelia, Kashia, Dvali, Azarovi; Kiteishvili, Chakvetadze, Kochorashvili; Mikautadze, Kvaratskhelia.
  • Spain (4-3-3): Simón; Carvajal, Le Normand, Laporte, Grimaldo; Rodri, Merino, Fabián; Yamal, Morata, Williams.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Spain is the absolute favorite for this contest. The difference in class between the teams is colossal. It will be extremely difficult for Georgia to offer any resistance to one of the strongest national teams in the world, even on their home turf.

  • Main Prediction: Spain to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. 'La Furia Roja' should comfortably defeat a less-skilled opponent to prove their championship ambitions.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. The last two head-to-head meetings between these teams were very high-scoring (7-1 and 3-1 in favor of Spain). Given the visitors' attacking power, a high-scoring match is to be expected.

Cyprus vs Austria: Match Preview

The teams approach this match with different objectives. The Austrian national team, under Ralf Rangnick, is one of the group leaders and the main contender for a direct ticket to the World Cup. The Cyprus national team, on the other hand, is one of the underdogs and is playing for pride. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Austrians, who have won all four previous encounters, including two victories in the Euro 2020 qualifiers (4-1 and 2-1).

Team Form and Analysis

Cyprus

The Cyprus national team relies on organized defense and commitment. At home, with the support of their fans, the Cypriots are capable of causing problems, but a lack of class and experience in matches against top-tier national teams is a major issue. Against one of the most high-pressing teams in Europe, the hosts will adopt a deep defensive strategy.

Austria

'Das Team' is on the rise and displays an intense and aggressive style of football based on gegenpressing. The team is packed with stars from the German Bundesliga, such as Marcel Sabitzer, Konrad Laimer, and Christoph Baumgartner. The Austrians will aim to dominate from the first minutes and try to score an early goal to secure a crucial three points.

Turkey vs Bulgaria: Match Preview

Both teams come into this match needing to pick up points. The Turkish national team, under Vincenzo Montella, is one of the group favorites and will be looking to secure three points to strengthen their position. The Bulgarian national team, in turn, is a solid mid-tier side capable of challenging and taking points from any opponent. The head-to-head history between these teams includes 10 matches, with the advantage on the side of the Turkish team, who have 5 wins to Bulgaria's 2. The last official meeting between the teams in 2005 ended in a 3-1 victory for Turkey.

Team Form and Analysis

Turkey

The 'Crescent-Stars' rely on technical and attacking football. At home, with incredible support from their fans, the Turks are particularly formidable. The team is packed with talent from Europe's top leagues, such as Hakan Çalhanoğlu, Kenan Yıldız, and Arda Güler. Turkey will aim to dominate from the first minutes and try to score an early goal.

Bulgaria

The 'Lions,' under Ilian Iliev, are undergoing a generational change but remain a resilient opponent. The team focuses on an organized defense and fast counter-attacks. Against the technical Turks, the Bulgarians are likely to adopt a deep defensive strategy. The team's leader is captain Kiril Despodov.

The Turkish national team are the clear favorites for this match on their home turf. Their higher class, team chemistry, and the home-stadium advantage should be decisive. It will be difficult for Bulgaria to impose their game and take points from Istanbul.

Denmark

The 'Danish Dynamite' are in excellent form, having secured five wins in their last six matches. The team has been phenomenally prolific, scoring 12 goals in four qualifying matches while conceding only one. At home, the Danes have won 9 of their last 11 qualifying matches. The leader of their attack is Manchester United superstar Rasmus Højlund.

Belarus

The Belarus national team is in a deep crisis, having lost their last five matches in a row. The team has had a disastrous qualifying campaign, suffering heavy defeats to Greece (1-5) and Denmark (0-6). In their last 11 World Cup qualifying matches, the Belarusians have suffered 11 defeats. It will be extremely difficult for them to hope for a positive result in an away match against one of Europe's strongest national teams.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Denmark (3-5-2): Schmeichel; Vestergaard, Andersen, Christensen; Dorgu, Damsgaard, Nørgaard, Hjulmand, Isaksen; Højlund, Frøkjær.
  • Belarus (5-4-1): Lapoukhov; Pechenin, Polyakov, Politevich, Parkhomenko, Begunov; Gromyko, Yablonskiy, Ebong, Malashevich; Barkovskiy.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Denmark is the absolute favorite for this contest. The difference in class, current form, the home-field advantage, and the result of the first match make a victory for the hosts almost a foregone conclusion.

  • Main Prediction: Denmark to Win with a (-3) Handicap. The Danes have been crushing all their group opponents, and a home match against a demotivated underdog is unlikely to be an exception.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Denmark to Win to Nil. The Belarusians have failed to score a single goal against the Danes in three head-to-head meetings. Given the difference in class, the 'Danish Dynamite' are likely to prevent their opponent from scoring.

Bosnia and Herzegovina vs Romania: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a key European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team hosts its main competitor for qualification from the group, Romania, at the Bilino Polje stadium in Zenica. This is a 'six-pointer' that could be decisive in the distribution of spots for the World Cup.

Kick-off: November 15, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Bilino Polje, Zenica Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Bosnia and Herzegovina vs Romania: Match Preview

The teams approach this match as direct competitors for the second spot in Group H, which grants a place in the play-offs. Currently, Bosnia is three points ahead of Romania and occupies that second position. Romania is in good form, having won three of their last six matches and performing well on the road. Bosnia, in contrast, has struggled at home, losing four of their last seven matches on their home turf. The head-to-head history favors the Bosnians, who have won 3 of the last 5 encounters, including a 1-0 victory in Bucharest in March of this year.

Team Form and Analysis

Bosnia and Herzegovina

Sergej Barbarez's team will be highly motivated to secure a victory over their direct competitor and virtually guarantee a place in the play-offs. However, the Bosnians have severe personnel problems: due to injuries and suspensions, Edin Džeko, Ermedin Demirović, Ivan Šunjić, Nihad Mujakić, and others will miss the match. This significantly weakens both the attacking and defensive power of the team.

Romania

The 'Tricolours' understand that they need to get points in Zenica to keep their World Cup qualification hopes alive. The team will rely on an organized defense and fast counter-attacks. Given the opponent's personnel issues, the Romanians have an excellent chance to break their losing streak in matches against Bosnia and take home crucial points.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Bosnia and Herzegovina (3-5-2): Vasilj; Ahmedhodžić, Katić, Kolašinac; Dedić, Krunić, Pjanić, Cimirot, Gazibegović; Tabaković, Prevljak.
  • Romania (4-2-3-1): Niță; Rațiu, Drăgușin, Burcă, Bancu; M. Marin, R. Marin; Hagi, Stanciu, Coman; Pușcaș.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although bookmakers consider Bosnia a slight favorite, their personnel losses and unconvincing home form make this match unpredictable. Romania is in better form and will be desperate for a result.

  • Main Prediction: Romania to Win or Draw (X2). Given Bosnia's colossal personnel problems and Romania's good away form, the visitors should at least avoid defeat in this crucial match.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. The stakes in this match are very high. The teams are likely to play cautiously. Five of Bosnia's last six qualifiers have been low on corners, which also suggests a tight, defensive game.

Greece vs Scotland: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a key European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the Greek national team hosts its main competitor for the second spot in the group, Scotland, at the Olympic Stadium in Athens. This is a 'six-pointer' that could be decisive in the distribution of spots for the World Cup.

Kick-off: November 15, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Olympic Stadium, Athens Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Greece vs Scotland: Match Preview

Both teams come into this match as direct competitors for the second spot in the group, which grants a place in the play-offs. Both Greece and Scotland have had a successful start to the qualifiers, picking up points against the underdogs. This match will be a real test of their ambitions. The head-to-head history between these teams includes 12 matches, with a near-even balance: 4 wins for Greece, 5 for Scotland, and 3 draws.

Team Form and Analysis

Greece

The 'Ethniki,' under Gustavo Poyet, rely on a solid defense and tactical discipline. At home, with the support of their passionate fans, the Greek team plays with particular confidence. The team will be looking to secure three points against a direct competitor to create a comfortable gap. The team's leaders are Liverpool defender Kostas Tsimikas and Celtic striker Giorgos Giakoumakis.

Scotland

The 'Tartan Army,' under Steve Clarke, is known for its fighting spirit, athleticism, and skill from set pieces. The Scots are experiencing one of the best periods in their recent history, having performed successfully at Euro 2024. The team is packed with players from the English Premier League, such as Andrew Robertson, Scott McTominay, and John McGinn. The visitors will try to impose a physical battle and snatch points in Athens.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Greece (4-3-3): Vlachodimos; Baldock, Mavropanos, Chatzidiakos, Tsimikas; Bakasetas, Kourbelis, Mantalos; Masouras, Giakoumakis, Pelkas.
  • Scotland (5-4-1): Gunn; Hickey, Hendry, Hanley, Tierney, Robertson; McTominay, Gilmour, McGregor, McGinn; Adams.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A match between two evenly matched teams with similar styles is extremely difficult to predict. Greece has the home-field advantage, but Scotland is on the rise and has a more balanced squad.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. In a clash between the two main competitors for a play-off spot, where the cost of a mistake is very high, a draw seems the most likely outcome. Both teams will primarily focus on not losing.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. This is a meeting of two teams that focus on defense. A tight, tactical battle with a minimal number of goals is expected.

Switzerland vs Sweden: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a key European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the Switzerland national team hosts its main competitor for the top spot in the group, Sweden, in Bern. This is a battle between two top national teams that promises to be uncompromising and tense.

Kick-off: November 15, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Wankdorf Stadium, Bern Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Switzerland vs Sweden: Match Preview

Both teams come into this match as group leaders. Both Switzerland and Sweden have had a successful start to the qualifiers, securing maximum points in the opening rounds and creating a gap from their pursuers. This match is, in essence, a 'hidden final' for the top spot and a direct ticket to the World Cup. Switzerland, traditionally dominant at home, will be looking to secure three points. Sweden, in turn, has once again become a formidable force after a generational change. The head-to-head history between these teams includes 29 matches, with a near-even balance: 11 wins for each team and 7 draws.

Team Form and Analysis

Switzerland

The 'Nati,' under Murat Yakin, rely on a solid defense, the experience of their leaders, and tactical discipline. At home, with the support of their fans, the Swiss play with particular confidence. The squad features world-class stars such as Granit Xhaka, Manuel Akanji, and Yann Sommer. In attack, the main threat comes from Monaco forward Breel Embolo.

Sweden

The 'Blue and Yellow,' under Jon Dahl Tomasson, rely on athletic, physical football and set pieces. The team is packed with talent from top leagues, with strikers Alexander Isak and Viktor Gyökeres, as well as winger Dejan Kulusevski, being the standouts. The Swedes will aim to impose a physical battle and use their chances in fast counter-attacks.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Switzerland (3-4-3): Sommer; Elvedi, Akanji, Rodríguez; Widmer, Xhaka, Freuler, Ndoye; Shaqiri, Embolo, Vargas.
  • Sweden (4-4-2): Olsen; Holm, Hien, Lindelöf, Augustinsson; Kulusevski, Larsson, Ekdal, Forsberg; Isak, Gyökeres.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A match between two evenly matched top national teams is extremely difficult to predict. Switzerland has the home-field advantage, but Sweden has a more powerful and diverse attack.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. In a clash between the two main competitors for World Cup qualification, where the cost of a mistake is very high, a draw seems the most likely outcome. Neither team will want to take risks and lose to a direct competitor.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. This is a meeting of two teams with an excellent selection of players in attack. In 4 of the last 5 head-to-head meetings in Switzerland, both teams have scored. An exchange of goals is expected.
